source.title: Expression of Interest for 2026 WCA Continental Championships (March 2025)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Major Championship Team (WMCT), is pleased to be opening an Expression of Interest (EoI) period for the 2026 Asian, African, Oceanic, South American, and North American Championships, following the procedures defined in [Motion 22.2024.1.](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/22.2024.1%20-%20Major%20Championship%20Selection.pdf).

This EoI period will serve as an opportunity to discuss possibilities about the future of Continental Championships, and will allow the WMCT to have more information about the situation and the interest for these Championships. It is **strongly recommended** that an EoI is submitted if you intend to lodge a formal bid. 

Organizing a WCA Championship of this scale takes a significant amount of time and effort, spanning pre-event preparation, the championship itself, and post-event tasks. It is imperative that the Championship organizers, as well as a substantial proportion of the WCA Delegates in your country are committed to the preparation and the execution of this event. Please also note that applications **must** be made by a [WCA Recognized Regional Organization](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/organizations).

<!-- break -->

To register your interest please  send an email to [championships@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:championships@worldcubeassociation.org) **before March 31st, 2025, 23:59 UTC** with the subject line of “EoI from <Location/Team> to bid for <Continent> Championship 2026”. 
	
This email should include at least:
1. The Regional Organization that would be sending the application
2. Outline of the main organizing team, listing roles and experience
3. Location(s) of the championship
4. Possible venue(s)
	
Send as much information as you possibly can about the potential championship bid. The WMCT will look to open a formal two month bidding process after the EoI period concludes.
	
Email the WMCT [(championships@worldcubeassociation.org)](mailto:championships@worldcubeassociation.org) if you have any questions or need more information.

translation.title: 2026 年 WCA 大洲锦标赛承办意向征集（2025 年 3 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 大型锦标赛组（WMCT）现依照[动议 22.2024.1](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/22.2024.1%20-%20Major%20Championship%20Selection.pdf)的程序，征集 2026 年亚洲、非洲、大洋洲、南美洲及北美洲锦标赛的承办意向（EoI）。

本轮意向征集将为讨论未来大洲锦标赛的举办方案提供机会，也帮助 WMCT 了解各地的情况和承办意愿。如果计划正式申办，**强烈建议**先提交承办意向。

举办这一规模的 WCA 锦标赛，需要在赛前筹备、比赛期间和赛后事务上投入大量时间与精力。主办方和所在国家相当一部分的 WCA 代表都必须愿意参与筹备和执行。另请注意，申请**必须**由 [WCA 认可的地区组织](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/organizations)提交。

如有承办意向，请在 **2025 年 3 月 31 日 23:59 UTC 前**发送邮件至 [championships@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:championships@worldcubeassociation.org)，主题为“EoI from <Location/Team> to bid for <Continent> Championship 2026”。

邮件至少应包含：

1. 拟提交申请的地区组织
2. 主要筹备团队的简介，包括各成员职责和经验
3. 比赛拟举办地点
4. 可能采用的场馆

请尽可能详细地介绍潜在的申办方案。意向征集结束后，WMCT 计划启动为期两个月的正式申办程序。

如有疑问或需要更多信息，请发邮件联系 WMCT（[championships@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:championships@worldcubeassociation.org)）。
